date.as_written: nepālavarṣe rasanetrakhendu āṣāḍhamāse dhavale ca pakṣa(!) śivatithibhe ca tathā jīvavāre

notes: Chronogram rasanetrakhendu represents NS 1026 (rasa=6, netra=2, kha=0, indu=1), which the catalogue mistakenly recorded in forward order as 6201. 'likhāyita' literally means caused to be written (commissioned), though in Nepalese colophons it is frequently used interchangeably with 'likhita' (written).
